lora.trainable_selection: named_parameters() with requires_grad and 'lora_' in name

meta._recovery_note: This meta block was reconstructed by hand from the seed-42 DTD run (outputs/a1_rr_e4_dtd.json) plus the seed-44 run-log line 'train pairs: {... seed 44 ... ckpt_dir outputs/a1_rr_ckpt\\seed44\\dtd}', because the machine was rebooted after training finished and the evaluation step never wrote a JSON. For DTD the training sampler draws the ENTIRE 1 880-image train split for every seed, so the data block is seed-independent apart from the shuffle order; every evaluated quantity is measured fresh by tools/a1_h_e4_seed.py --seed-json, which overwrites meta.seed and meta.checkpoint from its own arguments.

recovered_evaluation.reason: the training run completed and wrote its epoch checkpoints, but the evaluation step was lost (process killed / machine rebooted)
recovered_evaluation.note: protocol identical to the original run: same evaluator, same frozen references, same 5000-image sample, same 50k pass; only the JSON is rewritten
